intent: A courtly cliff-valkyrie gown in sky blue, cloud white and blue steel — a winged steel helm, a white stomacher and a short white cape over a long bell skirt — that reads from the high camera as one pale blue bell under a white-winged crown.
reason: Cliff valkyrie: the run's clearest armoured gown, a pale sky-blue steel A-line with a real bell from the hip under a white bow-winged helm, one pale blue bell from the ARPG camera (second critic 7.35, first; first critic 7.13, first).
first_fix: Slim the full-width block sleeves and drop the shoulder caps; carry the light colours round the dark back; add wind movement and rock-tan trim.
